annotatedSteps.description: Identify the parental genotype combination for a 1:1 phenotypic ratio
annotatedSteps.studentWork:
50% tall and 50% short means both parents are hybrid.
Tt and Tt
annotatedSteps.teacherAnnotation: × Incorrect. A cross between two hybrids (Tt × Tt) gives a 3:1 ratio (75% tall : 25% short). A 1:1 ratio (50% tall : 50% short) is obtained from a test cross between Tt and tt.

teacherNote: Marked against: Correct option (C) Tt and tt (1). A cross between two heterozygous plants (Tt × Tt) produces 75% tall and 25% short offspring. To obtain an equal 50:50 ratio of tall to short plants, the cross must be between a heterozygous plant and a homozygous recessive plant (Tt × tt).
